outgoingFlows.description: Approximate infection process driven by effective reproduction under interventions; paper models infections through Rt and generation-time renewal rather than explicit compartmental force of infection
Resolution / removal from infectiousness; included as a compartmental approximation because the paper models infections implicitly rather than with explicit recovery transitions
Fatal progression from latent infections to observed deaths; approximates the paper's infection-to-death linkage

parameters.name: Population11Countries
parameters.description: Approximate combined population of the 11 European countries analysed in the paper

parameters.name: InitialRt
parameters.description: Average initial reproduction number estimated across the 11 countries before interventions

parameters.name: GenerationIntervalDays
parameters.description: Representative generation interval placeholder retained for semantic fidelity to the renewal-process model

parameters.name: BaseTransmissionRate
parameters.description: Compartmental approximation of transmission intensity derived from initial Rt

parameters.name: PublicEventsBanEffect
parameters.description: Relative multiplier for public-events-ban effect on transmission; paper found non-lockdown intervention effects hard to identify separately

parameters.name: SchoolClosureEffect
parameters.description: Relative multiplier for school-closure effect on transmission

parameters.name: SelfIsolationEffect
parameters.description: Relative multiplier for case-based self-isolation effect on transmission

parameters.name: SocialDistancingEffect
parameters.description: Relative multiplier for encouraged social distancing effect on transmission

parameters.name: LockdownEffect
parameters.description: Approximate remaining transmission multiplier under lockdown, corresponding to about 81 percent reduction in Rt reported in the paper

parameters.name: CombinedInterventionMultiplier
parameters.description: Combined multiplicative effect of interventions on transmission

parameters.name: EffectiveTransmissionRate
parameters.description: Effective transmission rate after interventions in the compartmental approximation

parameters.name: MeanOutcomeDelayDays
parameters.description: Representative delay scale retained to approximate progression from infection to outcome in a simple compartmental form

parameters.name: RemovalRate
parameters.description: Approximate non-fatal resolution rate from infected to removed

parameters.name: DeathRate
parameters.description: Small fatal transition rate used only to preserve explicit death outcome structure in this approximation; the paper infers deaths from convolution with infection-to-death distribution rather than direct compartmental death flow
